  let level3PreloadPromise=null;
  function level3AssetsReady(){ return Object.values(HD_L3).every(img=>img&&img.complete&&img.naturalWidth>0); }
  function preloadLevel3HD(){
    if(level3AssetsReady()) return Promise.resolve(true);
    if(level3PreloadPromise) return level3PreloadPromise;
    level3PreloadPromise=Promise.all(Object.values(HD_L3).map(img=>new Promise(resolve=>{
      if(img.complete&&img.naturalWidth>0) return resolve(true);
      const done=()=>resolve(true),fail=()=>resolve(false);
      img.addEventListener('load',done,{once:true}); img.addEventListener('error',fail,{once:true});
      if(img.decode) img.decode().then(done).catch(()=>{});
    }))).then(r=>r.every(Boolean)&&level3AssetsReady()).catch(()=>false);
    return level3PreloadPromise;
  }
  preloadLevel3HD();
  function isLevel3HD(){ return state&&state.mode!=='endless'&&state.levelIndex===2; }
  function drawLevel3BackdropHD(){
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    if(!drawImageCover(HD_L3.bg,Math.sin(state.time*.09)*5,Math.cos(state.time*.07)*4,1)){ctx.fillStyle=skyGradient('sunset');ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);}
    drawCloudLayer(state.farClouds,'sunset',.34);
    state.farIslands.forEach(i=>drawIsland(i,'sunset',true));
    drawCloudLayer(state.midClouds,'sunset',.48);
    state.nearIslands.forEach(i=>drawIsland(i,'sunset',false));
    drawWind();
    drawCloudLayer(state.nearClouds,'sunset',.62);
    drawBottomFog();
    if(state.flash>0){ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,248,214,${state.flash*.18})`;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);}
  }
